gaps.title: Working tree ≠ deployed staging commit
gaps.observation: 278 modified + 1799 untracked files vs HEAD 5ab1f8ba2229; staging /meta git_sha matches HEAD only.
gaps.impact: Local disk "latest" is not reproducible on staging via standard Fly deploy from HEAD; risk of historical snapshot drift vs developer working copy.
gaps.fix: Post–Reliability-Freeze: commit or stash intentional delta; S5 deploy API+Web from single commit; re-run alignment gate.

gaps.title: TN-P1-010 selector fix uncommitted (HEAD vs working tree)
gaps.observation: HEAD SELECTOR_ESCROW_OF=[0x87,0x90,0x6b,0x1e] vs working [0x83,0xa2,0x65,0xa7]; HEAD STATUS=[0x66,0x01,0xcb,0x31] vs working [0x20,0x0d,0x2e,0xd2]. Evidence TN-P1-010 CLOSED; staging reconcile compound_pass may pass via log path.
gaps.impact: Git HEAD still carries wrong eth_call selectors; redeploy from HEAD without commit would regress indexer RPC reads.
gaps.fix: Commit selector fix to HEAD; after freeze: redeploy tt-api-staging; re-run TN-P1-010 reconcile evidence (do not re-run closed soak/D6).

gaps.title: Untracked SQL migrations on disk
gaps.observation: 10 migration files untracked (CMS/Growth/guides/…); staging API parity PASS suggests DB may be ahead of git.
gaps.impact: Schema provenance not in VCS; fresh deploy/migrate from git-only clone would miss tables.
gaps.fix: Add migrations to git in dedicated commit; document staging migrate stamp in G2 evidence.

gaps.title: /meta missing governance_votes_token_address
gaps.impact: FE meta guard / governance vote panels may lack on-chain token address; observability drift.
gaps.fix: Set GOVERNANCE_VOTES_TOKEN_ADDRESS (+ expose in ChainConfig meta); redeploy API; verify /meta.

gaps.title: /meta missing staking_address
gaps.impact: FE meta guard / governance vote panels may lack on-chain token address; observability drift.
gaps.fix: Set GOVERNANCE_VOTES_TOKEN_ADDRESS (+ expose in ChainConfig meta); redeploy API; verify /meta.

gaps.title: /meta build.deployed_at null
gaps.impact: D18 deploy discipline / rollback audit weaker.
gaps.fix: Set TRAVELTRUST_DEPLOYED_AT on Fly release; optional build-arg at deploy.

gaps.title: Stripe test mode not surfaced in /meta
gaps.observation: check-staging-web-alignment WARN; TN-P1-005 evidence on file.
gaps.impact: PSP mode not machine-readable from meta; manual Fly secret verification required.
gaps.fix: Ensure TRAVELTRUST_ONBOARDING_STRIPE_ENABLED=1 + sk_test_* on Fly; extend meta onboarding block if needed.

gaps.title: Uncommitted indexer.rs delta vs HEAD
gaps.impact: Local indexer behavior may differ from staging until committed and deployed.
gaps.fix: Commit with TN-P1-010 bundle or split PR post-freeze.

gaps.title: TN-P1-009 P2FC 72h soak INFLIGHT
gaps.observation: Not a local↔staging skew; wall-clock graduation gate.
gaps.fix: Wait soak; post-soak graduation closure only.

gaps.title: G08 live Sepolia stake DEFER_③
gaps.observation: Matrix DEFER_③ · fork write PASS; intentional phase boundary.
gaps.impact: None for ② alignment if documented.
gaps.fix: Phase ③ mainnet / live TTG approve track.
